Homer vs Dante. Made in Seedance via @yapper_so 
⚔️ Homer wrote about heroes fighting monsters.
🔥 Dante wrote about monsters fighting sinners.
🖼️ Image — ChatGPT
🎬 Video — Seedance
💬 Prompt in the comments https://t.co/SzwzEj8x3U
content:
Use a single reference arena image (@Image1) and start the prompt with Scene opens @Image1 to lock the environment/characters across shots.

Structure Seedance prompts as timed shots (e.g., SHOT 1 (0–2.5s), SHOT 2 (2.5–5s)) and describe one clear action beat per shot to control pacing.

Specify camera direction per shot (TRACKING sprint, EXTREME CLOSE-UP impact, BEHIND character POV, RAPID ZOOM OUT, 360° ORBIT) to steer cinematography instead of leaving it implicit.

Add explicit slow-motion ramps with percentages and speed transitions (e.g., SLOW-MO 15% then Speed 15%>600%) to force dramatic time dilation and snap-back.

Call out impact emphasis techniques like 1-frame freeze + screen shake (EXTREME/MASSIVE) at hit moments to increase perceived force.

Use HUD/text overlays as prompt elements (ROUND 1/2, timer 99, health % changes, K.O., victory text, portrait, portrait orientation) to get game-fight presentation.

Quantify distances and scale (FLIES backward 8m, STOPS 10m away, 15m tall Poseidon, 20m high tsunami, arena 50–60m) to stabilize motion and relative size.

Describe VFX sources and transformations explicitly (demons burst out from book, ground crack races 10m, hellfire erupts 10m upward, Poseidon dissolves into water particles) to guide effect continuity.

End sequences with explicit finishing instructions (Freeze, Fade to red/black or blue/gold, End) to control the final frames and transitions.

ROUND 1
@Image1 (arena).

Scene opens @Image1. Text: "ROUND 1". Split arena: LEFT Dante — Hell (fire, demons). RIGHT Homer — Olympus (Greek columns). HUD: Red "DANTE", blue "HOMER", timer 99.

SHOT 1 (0-2.5s): BOOK STRIKE
DANTE SPRINTS at Homer (running fast). Camera TRACKING sprint. Raises DIVINE COMEDY book high (thick volume). SLAMS into Homer FACE (SMACK, massive impact). Camera EXTREME CLOSE-UP impact (book hitting face). Red liquid SPRAYS. SLOW-MO 15%: Homer HEAD SNAPS back. Speed 15%>600%. FLIES backward 8m (launched, spinning). Camera TRACKS flight. CRASHES GREEK COLUMN (SLAM, shaking). Slides down. Screen shake EXTREME. HUD: HOMER FLASHES RED 100%>70%.

SHOT 2 (2.5-5s): INCANTATION
Dante WALKS toward Homer (slow menacing). Opens book WIDE (pages spreading, glowing red). Camera EXTREME CLOSE-UP Dante FACE (demonic expression, eyes glowing). CHANTS incantation (dark words echoing, intense). SLOW-MO 20%: lips moving spell. Speed 20%>500%. From book: THREE DEMONS burst out (2m winged, red eyes, claws, fire, screeching). Demons FLY toward Homer (diving attack formation).

SHOT 3 (5-7.5s): DEMON ASSAULT
Camera BEHIND Dante (POV watching attack). Demons SWARM Homer (all three attacking, claws SLASHING). Homer tries DEFEND (struggling, overwhelmed). Multiple HITS (cutting, tearing). Red liquid SPRAYS everywhere. Homer THROWN backward 6m (launched). CRASHES ground (SLAM, dust). Speed 100%>550%. Screen shake. HUD: HOMER 70%>35% CRITICAL.

SHOT 4 (7.5-9.5s): CRACK EXTENDS
Camera Homer POV (looking up from ground, damaged vision). Dante APPROACHING (walking slow, looming, demons above). Camera SHAKY. Dante STOPS 10m away. STOMPS foot HARD (BOOM). Ground CRACKS (fissure opening beneath foot). Crack RACES toward Homer (splitting earth 10m, extending fast, approaching). Camera RAPID ZOOM OUT (extreme wide showing BOTH: Dante standing 10m away, crack running between them connecting, Homer on ground helpless, arena visible, columns background). Crack REACHES Homer. Pause tension.

SHOT 5 (9.5-12.5s): HELLFIRE ENGULFS
Camera WIDE (showing both Dante and Homer, 10m apart, crack between). From crack beneath Homer: HELLFIRE ERUPTS (10m flames EXPLODING upward, engulfing Homer completely, massive inferno). Camera maintains WIDE VIEW (showing Dante watching 10m away unharmed, Homer ENGULFED in flames center). SLOW-MO 10%: flames CONSUMING Homer (fire surrounding completely, burning). Speed 10%>700%. Homer BURNING (screaming agony, flailing arms desperately, trying escape, clothes burning). Camera 360° ORBIT Homer burning in 3D (traveling circle showing fire from all angles, closer view). Homer COLLAPSES (falling knees then face-first, still burning). Flames blazing. Screen shake. HUD: HOMER ZERO. Text: "K.O."

SHOT 6 (12.5-15s): DEMONIC LAUGH
Flames die (smoke rising). Homer motionless (defeated, burned). Camera PUSH IN Dante. Dante LAUGHS demonically (head back, sinister, echoing, maniacal). Camera EXTREME CLOSE-UP face laughing (demonic, eyes red, evil). Camera RAPID ZOOM OUT (extreme wide: Dante laughing, demons above, Homer's body, burned arena, columns damaged). Text SLAMS: "DANTE WINS! FATALITY!" (red/gold demonic font). Portrait. Freeze. Fade red/black. End.

ROUND 2
@Image1 (arena).

Scene opens @Image1. Text: "ROUND 2". Split arena: LEFT Dante — Hell (fire, demons). RIGHT Homer — Olympus (Greek columns). HUD: Red "DANTE", blue "HOMER", timer 99.

SHOT 1 (0-3s): BOXING COMBO
Homer CHARGES at Dante (sprinting fast, fists raised, aggressive). Camera 360° ORBIT around both during combo. Homer launches PROFESSIONAL BOXING COMBO: LEFT JAB face (CRACK) — RIGHT HOOK jaw (SMACK) — LEFT UPPERCUT chin (BOOM) — RIGHT CROSS temple (CRUNCH). Each punch = 1-frame freeze + screen shake + red liquid SPRAY. SLOW-MO 15%: teeth FLY OUT from mouth (3-4 teeth spinning air, white pieces). Speed 15%>650%. Camera EXTREME CLOSE-UP impacts between punches. Red liquid spraying multiple directions. Dante stumbling backward helpless. HUD: DANTE FLASHES RED 100%>55%.

SHOT 2 (3-5.5s): SPARTAN KICK
Homer steps back. Winds up MASSIVE straight kick. Camera EXTREME CLOSE-UP foot approaching Dante chest. SLAM (devastating front kick center mass). 1-frame freeze + EXTREME screen shake. Speed 100%>800%. Dante LAUNCHES backward 10m (body flying, spinning, horizontal, helpless). Camera BECOMES Dante (POV flying backward through arena, ground blurring, sky spinning). CRASHES into ROCK WALL (SLAMMING stone, CRACKING rock deep, crater forming, dust EXPLOSION). Slides down (falling to ground, defeated pose, red-stained, teeth missing). Screen shake MASSIVE. HUD: DANTE 55%>25% CRITICAL.

SHOT 3 (5.5-8.5s): POSEIDON RISES
Homer center arena. Raises BOTH ARMS skyward (commanding gesture, powerful). CHANTING Greek incantation (ancient words, echoing, intense, summoning). Camera EXTREME CLOSE-UP Homer face (determined, eyes glowing blue, mouth moving spell). Behind Homer: ocean SWELLS (water RISING, waves GROWING). POSEIDON emerges from water (15m tall god rising, bearded, muscular, holding TRIDENT, translucent blue water form, magnificent, divine). Camera TILTS UP following Poseidon rising (showing ascent, revealing full 15m height). SLOW-MO 20%: water CASCADING off god body (droplets falling, majestic). Speed 20%>650%. Poseidon FULLY FORMED (standing towering, trident raised high, ocean behind, powerful pose). Camera RAPID ZOOM OUT (extreme wide showing scale: 2m Homer, 15m Poseidon behind, ocean, arena 50m visible, Dante small distance). God ready.

SHOT 4 (8.5-12s): TSUNAMI SWEEP
Poseidon THRUSTS trident forward (commanding ocean, muscles flexing). GIANT WAVE launches (20m high tsunami forming, blue water wall, white foam, MASSIVE). Camera BEHIND wave (showing wall approaching, towering). Wave RUSHES forward (accelerating, roaring water sound). Dante tries STAND (struggling up from rocks, seeing wave, terror). Wave CRASHES into Dante (SLAMMING, water CRUSHING, engulfing completely). Dante SWEPT away (caught in water, tumbling, helpless, dragged). Camera 360° ORBIT wave impact in 3D (traveling full circle showing water from ALL angles, scale massive). SLOW-MO 10%: Dante tumbling inside wave (water surrounding, being carried toward ocean). Speed 10%>800%. Wave CARRIES Dante into ocean (sweeping into deep water, disappearing beneath surface). Bubbles. Dante SINKS (descending into depths, gone). Screen shake EXTREME. HUD: DANTE drops ZERO. Text: "K.O."

SHOT 5 (12-15s): EPIC VICTORY
Ocean surface calm (ripples fading, peaceful). Poseidon begins FADING (dissolving into water particles, disappearing). Homer walks forward (approaching water's edge, stopping). Stands VICTORIOUS (arms raised high, fists up, champion pose, powerful stance). Camera PUSH IN Homer (zooming to triumphant face, satisfied expression). Camera RAPID ZOOM OUT (extreme wide ascending: Homer center with raised arms, calm ocean behind, faded Poseidon particles, arena visible 60m scale, Greek columns standing, destroyed Dante side). Text SLAMS center: "HOMER WINS! FATALITY!" (blue/gold Greek font glowing, wave effect). Portrait appears corner. Ocean waves gentle background. Freeze victory pose. Fade to blue/gold. End.

---
Utiliza una sola imagen de referencia de la arena (@Image1) y comienza el prompt con Scene opens @Image1 para fijar el entorno/personajes a lo largo de las tomas.

Estructura los prompts de Seedance como tomas cronometradas (por ejemplo, SHOT 1 (0–2.5s), SHOT 2 (2.5–5s)) y describe una acción clara por toma para controlar el ritmo.

Especifica la dirección de la cámara por toma (TRACKING sprint, EXTREME CLOSE-UP impact, BEHIND character POV, RAPID ZOOM OUT, 360° ORBIT) para dirigir la cinematografía en lugar de dejarla implícita.

Añade rampas de cámara lenta explícitas con porcentajes y transiciones de velocidad (por ejemplo, SLOW-MO 15% luego Speed 15%>600%) para forzar una dilatación dramática del tiempo y un retorno brusco.

Destaca técnicas de énfasis de impacto como 1-frame freeze + screen shake (EXTREME/MASSIVE) en momentos de golpe para aumentar la fuerza percibida.

Usa superposiciones de HUD/texto como elementos del prompt (ROUND 1/2, timer 99, cambios de salud %, K.O., texto de victoria, retrato, orientación del retrato) para obtener una presentación de pelea de juego.

Cuantifica distancias y escala (FLIES backward 8m, STOPS 10m away, 15m tall Poseidon, 20m high tsunami, arena 50–60m) para estabilizar el movimiento y el tamaño relativo.

Describe las fuentes y transformaciones de VFX explícitamente (demons burst out from book, ground crack races 10m, hellfire erupts 10m upward, Poseidon dissolves into water particles) para guiar la continuidad del efecto.

Termina las secuencias con instrucciones de finalización explícitas (Freeze, Fade to red/black or blue/gold, End) para controlar los fotogramas finales y las transiciones.

Cámara TRACKS vuelo. CHOCA contra COLUMNA GRIEGA (SLAM, temblor). Se desliza hacia abajo. Screen shake EXTREME. HUD: HOMERO PARPADEA ROJO 100%>70%.

SHOT 2 (2.5-5s): INCANTACIÓN
Dante CAMINA hacia Homero (lento y amenazante). Abre el libro AMPLIAMENTE (páginas extendiéndose, brillando rojo). Cámara EXTREME CLOSE-UP cara de Dante (expresión demoníaca, ojos brillando). RECITA una incantación (palabras oscuras resonando, intenso). SLOW-MO 20%: labios moviéndose con el hechizo. Velocidad 20%>500%. Del libro: TRES DEMONIOS emergen (2m alados, ojos rojos, garras, fuego, chillando). Los demonios VUELAN hacia Homero (formación de ataque en picada).

SHOT 3 (5-7.5s): ASALTO DEMONÍACO

Múltiples GOLPES (cortando, desgarrando). Líquido rojo SALPICA por todas partes. Homero es LANZADO hacia atrás 6m (lanzado). CHOCA contra el suelo (SLAM, polvo). Velocidad 100%>550%. Screen shake. HUD: HOMERO 70%>35% CRÍTICO.

SHOT 4 (7.5-9.5s): GRIETA SE EXTIENDE
Cámara POV de Homero (mirando hacia arriba desde el suelo, visión dañada). Dante ACERCÁNDOSE (caminando lento, imponente, demonios arriba). Cámara TEMBLOROSA. Dante SE DETIENE a 10m de distancia. PISA fuerte (BOOM). El suelo SE RAJA (fisura abriéndose bajo el pie). La grieta AVANZA hacia Homero (partiendo la tierra 10m, extendiéndose rápido, acercándose). Cámara RAPID ZOOM OUT (extremo ancho mostrando AMBOS: Dante de pie a 10m de distancia, grieta corriendo entre ellos conectando, Homero en el suelo indefenso, arena visible, columnas de fondo). La grieta LLEGA a Homero. Pausa de tensión.

SHOT 5 (9.5-12.5s): INFIERNO ENVUELVE
Cámara ANCHA (mostrando tanto a Dante como a Homero, 10m de distancia, grieta entre ellos). Desde la grieta bajo Homero: INFIERNO ERUPTA (llamas de 10m EXPLOTANDO hacia arriba, envolviendo completamente a Homero, inferno masivo). Cámara mantiene VISTA ANCHA (mostrando a Dante observando a 10m de distancia ileso, Homero ENVUELTO en llamas en el centro). SLOW-MO 10%: llamas CONSUMIENDO a Homero (fuego rodeando completamente, quemando). Velocidad 10%>700%. Homero ARDIENDO (gritando de agonía, agitando brazos desesperadamente, intentando escapar, ropa ardiendo). Cámara 360° ORBIT Homero ardiendo en 3D (circulando mostrando el fuego desde todos los ángulos, vista más cercana). Homero SE DERRUMBA (cayendo de rodillas y luego de cara, aún ardiendo). Llamas ardiendo. Screen shake. HUD: HOMERO CERO. Texto: "K.O."

SHOT 6 (12.5-15s): RISA DEMONÍACA
Las llamas se apagan (humo elevándose). Homero inmóvil (derrotado, quemado). Cámara PUSH IN Dante. Dante RÍE demoníacamente (cabeza hacia atrás, siniestro, resonante, maniaco). Cámara EXTREME CLOSE-UP cara riendo (demoníaco, ojos rojos, malvado). Cámara RAPID ZOOM OUT (extremo ancho: Dante riendo, demonios arriba, cuerpo de Homero, arena quemada, columnas dañadas). Texto GOLPEA: "¡DANTE GANA! ¡FATALITY!" (fuente demoníaca roja/oro). Retrato. Congelar. Desvanecer a rojo/negro. Fin.

Utilisez une seule image de référence de l'arène (@Image1) et commencez le prompt avec Scene opens @Image1 pour verrouiller l'environnement/personnages à travers les plans.

Structurez les prompts Seedance comme des plans chronométrés (par exemple, SHOT 1 (0–2.5s), SHOT 2 (2.5–5s)) et décrivez une action claire par plan pour contrôler le rythme.

Spécifiez la direction de la caméra par plan (TRACKING sprint, EXTREME CLOSE-UP impact, BEHIND character POV, RAPID ZOOM OUT, 360° ORBIT) pour orienter la cinématographie au lieu de la laisser implicite.

Ajoutez des ralentis explicites avec pourcentages et transitions de vitesse (par exemple, SLOW-MO 15% puis Speed 15%>600%) pour forcer une dilatation dramatique du temps et un retour brusque.

Mettez en avant les techniques d'accentuation de l'impact comme 1-frame freeze + screen shake (EXTREME/MASSIVE) aux moments de coup pour augmenter la force perçue.

Utilisez des superpositions HUD/texte comme éléments de prompt (ROUND 1/2, timer 99, changements de santé %, K.O., texte de victoire, portrait, orientation du portrait) pour obtenir une présentation de combat de jeu.

Quantifiez les distances et l'échelle (FLIES backward 8m, STOPS 10m away, 15m tall Poseidon, 20m high tsunami, arena 50–60m) pour stabiliser le mouvement et la taille relative.

Décrivez explicitement les sources et transformations VFX (demons burst out from book, ground crack races 10m, hellfire erupts 10m upward, Poseidon dissolves into water particles) pour guider la continuité des effets.

Terminez les séquences avec des instructions de finition explicites (Freeze, Fade to red/black or blue/gold, End) pour contrôler les derniers cadres et transitions.

SHOT 1 (0-2.5s) : COUP DE LIVRE
DANTE SPRINT vers Homer (courant vite). Caméra TRACKING sprint. Soulève le livre DIVINE COMEDY haut (gros volume). FRAPPE le visage d'Homer (SMACK, impact massif). Caméra EXTREME CLOSE-UP impact (livre frappant le visage). Liquide rouge ÉCLABOUSSE. SLOW-MO 15% : la TÊTE d'Homer RECOULE. Vitesse 15%>600%. VOL en arrière de 8m (lancé, tournant). Caméra SUIVANT le vol. S'ÉCRASE sur une COLONNE GRECQUE (SLAM, secouant). Glisse vers le bas. Secousse de l'écran EXTREME. HUD : HOMER CLIGNOTE ROUGE 100%>70%.

SHOT 2 (2.5-5s) : INCANTATION
Dante MARCHE vers Homer (lentement menaçant). Ouvre le livre GRAND (pages s'étalant, rougeoyant). Caméra EXTREME CLOSE-UP visage de Dante (expression démoniaque, yeux brillants). CHANTE une incantation (mots sombres résonnant, intense). SLOW-MO 20% : lèvres bougeant le sort. Vitesse 20%>500%. Du livre : TROIS DÉMONS surgissent (ailés de 2m, yeux rouges, griffes, feu, criant). Les démons VOLENT vers Homer (formation d'attaque plongeante).

SHOT 3 (5-7.5s) : ASSAUT DÉMONIAQUE
Caméra DERRIÈRE Dante (POV regardant l'attaque). Les démons ENVAHISSENT Homer (les trois attaquant, griffes LACÉRANT). Homer essaie de SE DÉFENDRE (luttant, submergé). Multiples COUPS (coupant, déchirant). Liquide rouge ÉCLABOUSSE partout. Homer JETÉ en arrière de 6m (lancé). S'ÉCRASE au sol (SLAM, poussière). Vitesse 100%>550%. Secousse de l'écran. HUD : HOMER 70%>35% CRITIQUE.

SHOT 4 (7.5-9.5s) : FISSURE S'ÉTEND
Caméra POV d'Homer (regardant vers le haut depuis le sol, vision endommagée). Dante APPROCHE (marchant lentement, menaçant, démons au-dessus). Caméra TREMBLANTE. Dante S'ARRÊTE à 10m. FRAPPE le pied FORT (BOOM). Le sol SE FISSURE (fissure s'ouvrant sous le pied). La fissure COURT vers Homer (terre se fendant sur 10m, s'étendant rapidement, approchant). Caméra RAPID ZOOM OUT (extrême large montrant LES DEUX : Dante debout à 10m, fissure courant entre eux connectant, Homer au sol impuissant, arène visible, colonnes en arrière-plan). La fissure ATTEINT Homer. Pause de tension.

SHOT 5 (9.5-12.5s) : ENFER ENGLOUTIT
Caméra LARGE (montrant à la fois Dante et Homer, 10m de distance, fissure entre). De la fissure sous Homer : ENFER ÉRUPT (flammes de 10m EXPLOSANT vers le haut, engloutissant Homer complètement, immense incendie). Caméra maintient VUE LARGE (montrant Dante regardant à 10m de distance indemne, Homer ENGLOUTI par les flammes au centre). SLOW-MO 10% : flammes CONSOMMANT Homer (feu entourant complètement, brûlant). Vitesse 10%>700%. Homer BRÛLE (cri d'agonie, bras agitant désespérément, essayant de s'échapper, vêtements brûlant). Caméra 360° ORBIT Homer brûlant en 3D (cercle de voyage montrant le feu sous tous les angles, vue rapprochée). Homer S'EFFONDRE (tombant à genoux puis face contre terre, toujours brûlant). Flammes flamboyantes. Secousse de l'écran. HUD : HOMER ZÉRO. Texte : "K.O."

SHOT 6 (12.5-15s) : RIRE DÉMONIAQUE
Les flammes s'éteignent (fumée montant). Homer immobile (vaincu, brûlé). Caméra PUSH IN Dante. Dante RIT démoniaquement (tête en arrière, sinistre, résonnant, maniaque). Caméra EXTREME CLOSE-UP visage riant (démoniaque, yeux rouges, maléfique). Caméra RAPID ZOOM OUT (extrême large : Dante riant, démons au-dessus, corps d'Homer, arène brûlée, colonnes endommagées). Texte FRAPPE : "DANTE WINS! FATALITY!" (police démoniaque rouge/or). Portrait. Freeze. Fade red/black. End.

---
単一の参照アリーナ画像 (@Image1) を使用し、プロンプトを Scene opens @Image1 で始めて、ショット間で環境/キャラクターを固定します。

Seedance プロンプトをタイムショットとして構成し (例: SHOT 1 (0–2.5s), SHOT 2 (2.5–5s))、1つの明確なアクションビートをショットごとに記述してペースを制御します。

ショットごとにカメラの方向を指定し (TRACKING sprint, EXTREME CLOSE-UP impact, BEHIND character POV, RAPID ZOOM OUT, 360° ORBIT)、暗黙のままにせずに撮影技法を指示します。

明示的なスローモーションランプをパーセンテージと速度の変化で追加し (例: SLOW-MO 15% then Speed 15%>600%)、劇的な時間の伸縮とスナップバックを強制します。
